Name: Kullanmuru - mid size hybrid farm
Author: Lykkio
Description:
[size=3]Welcome to a new home! Your personal stretch of coastline - nearly untouched - borders on secluded woods dominated by a massive ancient tree.

This mod [b]does not[/b] [b]replace*[/b] any farm, it adds a new one. Slightly larger than vanilla maps but not all the space is open.
*An optional file which replaces the default farm has been added for mobile players.

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Getting started[/b]: Your gift contains a beehouse, 6 Jazz seeds, and 6 Parsnip seeds[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Getting around[/b]: More paths in and out of the forest will unlock as you upgrade your tools. There are a few convenient interactive warp points as well. If you can't find the cave (it does start hidden) check the pictures![/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b]Farming[/b]: One large open area intended for farming, and a few smaller open areas.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b]Foraging[/b]: Berry bushes can be found in the woods. Beach forage can also spawn.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b]Ranching[/b]: The Northeast area is designed for animals, with ample blue grass and animal barriers. [/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b]Fishing[/b]: Ocean fish can be found in, you guessed it, the ocean! Everywhere else has fish from the Secret Woods.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
As a side note, I'd like to recommend the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better Beehouses[/url] for use with this map. The smaller farming areas were designed with flower fields in mind, and it will help you out a little with your starting gift. Maybe I'm just biased and want honey to be better! Love this mod.

[i]SVE: I would try configuring your Enchanted Grove warp to 23, 22 or 83, 30. If you have better ideas please post them![/i][/size]
